column1: # THE LANE PROMISE (internal/slowtest/require.go): what a test that needs a
# program does, by what the lane says it provides and what is on PATH.
# program  found   lane                     verdict  text the verdict carries
#   found: path (the program is on PATH), env (only $NODE / $TSC names it),
#          stale-env (the variable names nothing, the program is on PATH),
#   lane: the SCHEMA_REQUIRE_* variable the lane sets to 1, or - for none
# A lane that declares the program and does not have it is red, naming the
# variable and the reason the skip would have given:

column5: SCHEMA_REQUIRE_TSC=1 says this lane provides what the test needs, and it is missing: no tsc on PATH: set TSC
SCHEMA_REQUIRE_NODE=1 says this lane provides what the test needs, and it is missing: no node on PATH: set NODE
SCHEMA_REQUIRE_CORPUS is set, so this lane is meant to have what the test needs, and it is missing: no tsc on PATH: set TSC
SCHEMA_REQUIRE_CORPUS is set, so this lane is meant to have what the test needs, and it is missing: no node on PATH: set NODE
